title: Neutralizing the Narrative: AI-Powered Debiasing of Online News Articles

bias_targets.methodology: Paragraph-level scoring (0-2 scale) by multiple Large Language Models (LLMs) to detect loaded language, stereotypes, and selective framing against racial minorities in crime-related news articles, validated against human ground truth annotations. The models also generated bias justifications and underwent an iterative debiasing evaluation.

Evaluated simultaneously with racial bias using LLM-based paragraph-level scoring to detect biased language, prejudice, and stereotyping directed at religious groups (e.g., Muslims) within crime journalism narratives.
